notes.title: Patch Notes 21/08/17
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I've just pushed live a patch that should help with some of the crashes and bugs people have been experiencing.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938353/4356cdad5301e436830f19b9a56d358c23018104.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Disabled all VR Plugins from attempting to run on startup. This should stop SteamVR from appearing when you run Unbox.
[*]Further optimisations. Game should run even faster on less powerful systems.
[*]FPS Cap will now load and set itself properly when Unbox starts. By default FPS is set to 60fps.
[*]Graphics settings now get loaded immediately. This should stop the crash during load screens some people have been seeing.
[*]Vehicle weights have been updated to make them less floaty.
[/list]

Thank you everyone who has brought issues to our attention, we hope you enjoy Unbox: Newbie's Adventure! ːuBounceː

notes.title: Unbox at Play Expo Manchester!
notes.notes:
Unbox has been out for just over a month and we couldn't be happier with the launch. We're getting so many requests for new characters, maps and platforms to play Unbox on! We are reading everything you send us and there will be some cool announcements coming shortly. Make sure to follow us for all the latest Unbox updates: 

Facebook: [url=]https://www.facebook.com/prospectgames/[/url]
Twitter: [url=]https://twitter.com/ProspectGames[/url]
Unbox Mailing List: [url=]http://eepurl.com/caLOWj[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938353/e13992d0d11c3e8ebb89727a9708bd4f0dc2fd21.jpg[/img]
We're pleased to announce that Unbox was in the top 20 [b](of 153!)[/b]  games in the Rezzed section of EGX 2016! Plenty of Unbox fans seeked us out on the showfloor and we think we may have gained a few new ones! 


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938353/963cf2d1a70adaa89ae79e7c4872fa3becaa29b6.png[/img]
We're on a roll with events, if you're in the North West (UK) then make sure you come to the Unbox stall at Play Expo Manchester! We'll have multiple stands, stickers and a chance to win free copies of Unbox! 

We recently launched a small patch that should have fixed the NPC dialogue issue some players were having, please let us know on the forums if you encounter any more bugs or issues: [url=]http://steamcommunity.com/app/512300/discussions/[/url]

Have a great #WorldSmileDay!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938353/4c4604df6599ee943035d1cfb740450f46d8ad8e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: UNBOX Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:

The UNBOX demo lets players explore a portion of Paradise Isles, one of four large worlds found in the full game. Collect all the tape, earn all of the stamps and get to know the locals along the way! 

There's a lot to see and do, so grab the demo and have fun!

It's been wonderful to see the positive response to Unbox and we've been enjoying a lot of the screenshots and videos the community has created!

Finally, Unbox will be playable at EGX in Birmingham! If you're going be sure to visit the stand, play some multiplayer and meet some of the developers!

notes.title: Free Ancient Shrine DLC & V1.03 Patch!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/uUshs6D.jpg[/img]

We're pleased to announce our [b]free DLC[/b], Ancient Shrine, has just gone live on Steam! Ancient Shrine is a local multiplayer arena map that is themed around the ruins of an ancient civilization... Who knows what secrets you might uncover?

Additionally, the Ancient Shrine DLC comes with two new cosmetics to dress up your box with: a Poseidon Crown, and a Poseidon Beard! Each cosmetic has a variety of colour pallette swaps to make your box the most feared cube in Atlantis.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qOS2Shi.jpg[/img]

Another week, another patch! Thank you to everybody who has supported Unbox during it’s launch. We are committed to further improving the game and adding content in the coming weeks and months, so let us know what you’d like to see in the comments or on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/512300/discussions/]our forums[/url]!

Here are the most recent additions and fixes to Unbox:
[list][*]Added “Shrine” to Unbox. Shrine is a new multiplayer Arena map themed around the ruins of an ancient civilization…
[*]Added two new cosmetics to Unbox: “Poseidon Crown” and “Poseidon Beard”, each with their own colour palettes.
[*]Added dynamic icons that now match any remapped keys.
[*]Added an option to disable Bounce’s help.
[*]Added a V-Sync option to the game, this will reduce screen tearing if enabled.
[*]Removed shadows from Gold Tape.
[*]Fixed an issue where setting Overall Quality to Low would set Texture Quality lower than desired, resulting in undesirable terrain.
[*]Art fixes, optimisations and camera clip layer fixes.
[*]Plenty of smaller bugs squashed.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.02 Patch is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Julq4zH.jpg[/img]
Thank you to everyone who has sent us bug reports, made forum posts and sent us direct messages, we're working to further improve the game and bring you more unboxing action in the upcoming weeks. We even have a few surprises planned!
n the meantime, we've fixed some critical issues and some other things that were bothering us, and Steam should now update Unbox with version 1.02.

[b]Below is a list of bug fixes and additions to the game:[/b]
[list]
    [*] Fixed an issue with VR turning on when the game is run. (Unbox does not support VR, but we’d left some plugins enabled which was turning it on for those of you with VR headsets. These have been disabled.)
    [*] Fixed an issue where opening the game for the first time resulted in flickering and audio, but no game. (Game will now open in Windowed mode the next time you open up Unbox. Resolution can still be changed in the options menu.)
    [*] Fans no longer exist without collision.
    [*] Fixed an issue with Swift Tailoring where Mouse and Keyboard controls did not work correctly.
    [*] Updated the Unbox OST with improved metadata.
    [*] Dash’s races now use the correct iconography.
    [*] Smoothed a bunch of issues with the NPC Helper Arrow.
    [*] Removed 180 from FOV menu.
    [*] Vehicle UI element fixes.
    [*] Fixed some spelling errors.
    [*] Removing gaps in the landscape at cave /tunnel entrances in Worlds 1, 2 and 3.
    [*] Checkpoints repositioned for better visibility 
    [*] Smoothed out jagged areas on the landscape 
    [*] Visual bugs: Fixing floating and oddly intersecting objects
    [*] Optimisation: changing materials, removing extra materials to reduce texture map count in Hub & World 2
    [*] Reduced texture/material count in W3 
    [*] Removed intersecting meshes W3
    [*] Additional LODS created for gameplay objects
    [*] Particle optimisation for pickups and collectables
    [*] Draw distance adjustments for further optimisation 
    [*] Numerous extra small bug fixes.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update, help us spread the cardboard craziness of Unbox! 

[url=https://twitter.com/ProspectGames]Twitter[/url] 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/prospectgames/]Facebook[/url]  

Enjoy!
